items.title: Define bounded project-level warn-to-enforce admission thresholds
items.context: Resolve Wave 4 policy questions with explicit claim taxonomies, supported adapter sufficiency, minimum sample size, zero mislabeled 3x1, 100% supported omission detection, and fail-closed threshold evaluation. Keep flat project scope; Wave 3A selective applicability remains excluded.

happy.desc: The canonical flat project policy mechanically requires transcripts for user-visible/orchestration claims, biting mutations for behavior/lifecycle/proof/safety with docs-only exemption, registered supported adapter profiles, at least 3 comparable matched samples in each cohort arm, an overall false-pass rate of 0 across every registered seeded defect class, 100% supported omission detection, 0% false blocks, 0 mislabeled 3x1 campaigns, waiver delta <=0, and a non-shrinking check inventory before warn-to-enforce admission can PASS.

edge.desc: Insufficient samples, unknown/partial/unsupported adapters, unexplained adapter disagreement, and claim-taxonomy gaps fail promotion with stable diagnostics while remaining honestly partial/unsupported; flat project scope is preserved and no selective Story/policy applicability is inferred without Wave 3A.

items.title: Implement opt-in enforcement and tested rollback without weakening checks
items.context: Promotion must mechanically consume a current verifier-owned PASS rollout-report receipt whose cohort meets the configured thresholds, plus existing full 3x2 high-risk review/quorum. Missing/stale/failing reports, degraded 3x1, increased waivers, or weaker checks fail closed. Rollback removes blocking without rewriting report/evidence history.
items.userSees: User sees `Acceptance rollout enforcement: PASS mode=enforce receipt=current quorum=full-3x2`; after rollback the UI shows `mode=warn blocking=false historyPreserved=true`.

happy.desc: An explicit project-level enforce promotion succeeds only when the gate mechanically verifies a current signed PASS rollout receipt whose cohort satisfies every configured threshold and a current genuine full-3x2 quorum; a tested rollback to warn/observe removes blocking while preserving the report, receipt, prior mode transitions, diagnostics, and evidence history byte-for-byte.

edge.desc: Observe, warn, and enforce compute the same status, ordered diagnostics, threshold evaluation, and receipt classification; observe/warn remain non-blocking, enforce alone changes admission, and repeated promotion/rollback is deterministic without selective per-Story behavior.

adversarial.desc: Clean control PASS → independently target missing/stale/tampered/failing receipt, degraded 3x1, forged host identity, positive waiver delta, weaker inventory, false-block, and omission-detection failures → each real gate consumer must reject with its named code → restoration must return clean PASS; rollback must never delete or rewrite the failed attempts or historical signed artifacts.
